messages:
zara: quick heads-up  we're rebalancing routing-silos for quota isolation tonight at 22:00 UTC. primary goal: reduce noisy-neighbor billing spikes for high-throughput tenants.
ajay: scope? do we move tenant shards or change route-to-silo mapping?
zara: we'll flip route-to-silo mapping for embed-heavy routes to use dedicated quota silos (silo-ded-01..03). no tenant shard moves. routing_tag=quota_silo_v2.
maya: important: invoice-preview currently aggregates by tenant_id only. if routing_tag is present we should surface per-silo previews to detect rebalancing-induced drift. ops wants side-by-side columns.
irene: UX: add small toggle "show silo breakdown" on invoice-preview and an annotation when quota_silo_v2 is active. ops asked for CSV export with silo column.
ops-bot: created dashboard card https://console.internal.redwood/d/quota_rebalance panels: per-silo_ingest, preview-delta, quota-util. alert rule "silo-preview-drift" at 0.5%.
sam: telemetry ask: emit event.enrich.meta.routing_tag and event.ledger.silo_id and include trace headers x-rw-request-id so we can diff preview vs ledger by silo.
billing-eng: also emit quota_bucket and effective_quota_rate in enrichment so ledger can apply same rate. last time we had mismatch because quota calc lived only in serving runtime.
rafael: runtime note: quota decision happens at proxy layer now; we'll add the routing_tag header there. ensure sidecar preserves header on gRPC. earlier we lost headers on content-type switch.
ajay: dedupe and attribution caveat: changing routing_tag will change partitioning logic for some routes. we may see duplicate invoice events when the same session hashes to a different partition. propose temporarily increasing dedupe window to 4m for affected tenants.
zara: agreed. canary plan: (1) 22:00 UTC 1 partition, 6 tenants tagging routing_tag=quota_silo_v2, (2) monitor 2h, (3) expand to 10% partitions for 24h, (4) full rollout. rollback triggers: preview-drift > 0.5% or dup_pct > 0.3% or invoice_delta > $0.50 per-tenant.
maya: small schema bump: enrichment add fields [routing_tag, quota_bucket, effective_quota_rate]; ledger already tolerant but add acceptance tests.
ops-bot: runbook created: "quota-silo-rebalance" with steps to flip mapping, monitor dashboard, and run backfill if needed.
irene: UI ask: when silo breakdown shown, display small help text "Siloed counts are provisional during rollout" and a link to runbook.
sam: preflight: run local replay of 2k synthetic sessions with canonical_route preserved and sampling disabled. run reconcile job to ensure preview==ledger within tolerance.
ajay: note on pricing: quota change may alter unit pricing for some reserved tenants (burst pricing). billing_eng please confirm no unexpected price-tier switch.
billing-eng: confirmed. adding acceptance: preview vs ledger per-silo must match within $0.02 for canary tenants. also add CSV field pricing_tier_applied.
rafael: sidecar will set x-rw-routing-tag header. patch posted, will include unit test preserving header across content-type changes.
zara: schedule: patch merge 21:00 UTC, canary flip 22:00 UTC. ping on thread when flipping.
[21:10] ops-bot: patch job sidecar-routing-tag-merge (job id job-14141) succeeded.
[22:01] zara: canary flip started on partition 13. applied routing_tag=quota_silo_v2 to 6 tenants.
[22:30] sam: initial telemetry: preview-drift 0.18% across cohort. no dup alerts. ingest per-silo looks healthy.
[22:45] maya: found a small mismatch: tenant t-309 shows preview higher by $0.12 due to effective_quota_rate rounding difference (server used float32). ledger expects int microcents.
ajay: fix: change runtime to calculate in integer microcents and emit effective_quota_rate_micro. will hotfix.
[23:05] ops-bot: hotfix deployed to runtime-silo-01 (job id job-14155).
[23:20] billing-eng: re-check t-309 preview: now matches within $0.01. good.
[23:40] rafael: noted one telemetry gap: some wiretap messages missing x-rw-request-id header for gRPC chunked uploads. will add header passthrough test and re-run.
irene: ops: please add UI banner showing canary tenants and a 1-click "exclude siloed counts from statement" toggle for safety.
zara: pausing expansion until header passthrough test completes.
ops-bot: alert created: quota-silo-header-missing if missing-request-id > 0.1% for 10m.
[23:59] ops-bot: canary paused. job job-14141 completed: pause triggered for header passthrough fix.
zara: summary: small canary exercised routing-tag propagation and uncovered microcents rounding + header passthrough issues. fixes deployed, will resume expansion after passthrough tests pass and one overnight validation run. reopening when ready.
